name: Murakumo
source:
Murakumo is a former "Emanon" agent who became [url=/c10849]Aoi[/url]'s ally. 
She is [url=/c10854]Kusanagi[/url]'s older twin sister. Both of them were test subjects in a genetic research when they were "Emanon" agents. Murakumo and Kusanagi had gained the ability to transform into coyotes with red mane as a result of these tests. 
Murakumo fights using brass knuckles with three long blades attatched to them. She has sexual feelings towards Kusanagi.

[Translated from [url=http://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noel]the Russian Wikipedia[/url].]
